quiz.q: Which return type makes the browser render HTML?
quiz.explain: Html sets content-type text/html; plain strings are sent as text/plain.

quiz.q: How do you return status 201 with a body?
quiz.explain: In a response tuple the status comes first, then headers, then the body.

quiz.q: What does `impl IntoResponse` as a return type mean?
options: Some type Axum can turn into a response — you don't have to name it
quiz.explain: `impl Trait` says 'a value of some type that implements this trait'.

quiz.q: Why does returning an `i32` from a handler fail to compile?
quiz.explain: Axum only accepts return types that implement IntoResponse, and a bare number doesn't: which content-type would it be?

flashcards.front: Status + headers + body in one return?
